# Soft-threshold selection

This archived report documents the `run_soft_threshold_selection()`
programmatic API. Advanced users should call that function directly from R
code.

## Evaluate and select a power

The default policy selects the smallest evaluated power whose signed model fit
reaches 0.80. Set `selection_mode = "automatic"` to use WGCNA's estimate, or
use `selection_mode = "manual"` together with `manual_power`.

```{r}
soft_threshold_result <- run_soft_threshold_selection(
  session_dir = session_dir,
  network_type = "signed",
  powers = default_soft_threshold_powers(),
  fit_cutoff = 0.80,
  selection_mode = "first_above_cutoff"
)

soft_threshold_result
```

## Diagnostic plots

```{r}
gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  soft_threshold_result$plots$scale_independence,
  soft_threshold_result$plots$mean_connectivity,
  nrow = 2
)
```

## Evaluated powers

```{r}
soft_threshold_result$fit_indices
```

The selected power is saved in `out/2_pt.Rdata`, preserving the artifact used
by Stage 3.
